The buyer is an out-of-town resident seeking a vacation home, motivated by the perceived recovery in the property market atmosphere.

articles.title: 海濱南岸兩房17年升值1.6倍
key_points: A unit in 海濱南岸 (Block 1, low floor) sold for $805萬元 after the owner reduced the asking price twice from an initial $860萬元.
The owner, who purchased the 481 sq. ft. unit in April 2009 for approximately $310.2萬元, realized a profit of $494.8萬元 (a 1.6x appreciation) after 17 years.
